name: craft
description: Capability discovery, durable tasks, verified workflows, evidence, and multi-agent orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Discover, orchestrate, evaluate, and reuse capabilities.
interface.longDescription: The complete Craft runtime composes Core, Knowledge, Memory, Capability, and Skill Quality behind a minimal route-first surface. In Codex it uses the current app as an embedded execution host and never launches a second Codex CLI by default.
defaultPrompt: Use Craft as the default orchestrator for this substantial goal.
Use Craft to create a safe incremental-development plan: preserve behavior, make the smallest change, then verify tests, coverage, and Git diff.
Use Craft to list experience candidates with enough Trial and Evidence history; do not publish anything.
